title: Iabin the second
summary: Raleigh names Iabin the second in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Iabin the second, who rebuilt Hazor and oppressed Israel twenty yeeres after Ehud. Not the Iabin Iosua slew. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.

reign.date: whom hee opprest twentie yeeres, after the death of Ehud
reign.citation: Raleigh, The History of the World (1617, EEBO-TCP A10357), Book II, Part I, Chapter VI, §. II, sig. 208b
reign.note: Body intake. How long he says this Iabin oppressed Israel. Not a yeere of the World. year_am stays null. This does not change the sort.

free_source_links.locator: Book II, Part I, Chapter VI, §. II, sig. 208b

alt_names: Iabin the second King of Hazor
